title: Brightmesh patches a router takeover flaw

facts.f01: A flaw lets attackers take over Brightmesh home routers
facts.f02: Affects 11 router models in the BX series
facts.f03: Brightmesh released firmware 4.2.1 to fix it
facts.f04: Researchers at security firm Quillstone found the flaw
facts.f05: Auto-updating routers get the fix within 48 hours
facts.f06: 3 older BX models won't be patched
facts.f07: Brightmesh will replace unpatched routers for free
facts.f08: Brightmesh shares fell 6% in early trading
facts.f09: The bug is in the routers' remote management service
facts.f10: The update turns remote management off by default
facts.f11: Older models lack storage for the new firmware
facts.f12: Cyber Readiness Office ordered agencies to patch or unplug
facts.f13: Agencies have until November 25 to comply
facts.f14: Attackers are already exploiting the flaw, the office says
facts.f15: Update took 6 minutes to install in testing
facts.f16: Download speeds fell 3% after the update in testing
facts.f17: Game latency rose from 14 ms to 15 ms after the update

byteward.title: Brightmesh patches a router flaw that let attackers take control
byteward.author: Dana Whitlock
body: [f01: A security flaw in Brightmesh home routers lets attackers take full control of them over the internet.] [f02: The flaw affects 11 router models in the company's BX series.]

[f03: Brightmesh released firmware version 4.2.1 on Wednesday to fix it.] [f04: Researchers at the security firm Quillstone found the flaw.] [f05: Routers set to update automatically will install the fix within 48 hours.]

If you've switched automatic updates off, don't wait for a reminder: install the update by hand as soon as you can. A router is the front door to every device in your home, and this one was left unlocked.

launch-desk.title: Brightmesh rushes out a patch for its router takeover flaw
launch-desk.author: Inez Calder
body: [f01: Brightmesh is scrambling after a flaw let attackers hijack its home routers.] [f03: Firmware 4.2.1, out now, closes the hole.]
[f06: Three older models won't get the fix.] [f07: Brightmesh says it will replace those routers for free.]
[f08: Brightmesh shares fell 6% in early trading.] Free replacements cost money, but losing customers' trust would cost more.

frametime.title: Brightmesh router flaw patched: we tested the fix
frametime.author: Wren Halloway
body: [f01: Brightmesh has patched a flaw that let attackers take over its home routers.] [f03: The fix arrives in firmware 4.2.1.] We installed it on our BX-600 to see what it costs.
[f15: The update took 6 minutes to install, including a restart.] [f16: Download speeds dropped 3% after the update in our testing.] [f17: Latency in online games went from 14 ms to 15 ms.]
Nobody will notice a millisecond. Install it.

ohm-and-bit.title: Brightmesh patches its router takeover flaw
ohm-and-bit.author: Rafe Okonkwo-Hart
body: [f01: Brightmesh has fixed a flaw that let attackers seize control of its home routers.] [f02: Eleven models in the BX series are affected.]
[f09: The bug sits in the routers' remote management service, the part that answers requests from the internet.] It's the worst possible place for a bug like this.
[f10: Along with the fix, the update switches remote management off by default.] Few owners will miss it.
The news is worse for owners of older hardware. [f06: Three older BX models won't be patched.] [f11: They don't have enough storage to hold the new firmware.]

bench-and-bill.title: Brightmesh patches a router flaw that let attackers take over
bench-and-bill.author: Owen Brightwater
body: [f01: A flaw in Brightmesh home routers lets attackers take them over remotely.] [f03: Brightmesh has released a fix in firmware 4.2.1.]

[f12: On Wednesday, the National Cyber Readiness Office ordered federal agencies to patch or unplug any affected Brightmesh routers on their networks.] [f13: Agencies have until November 25 to comply.]
[f14: The office says attackers are already exploiting the flaw.] Home users would be wise to move just as fast.

wirefold.title: Brightmesh patches router takeover flaw
body: Brightmesh released a security update on Wednesday after researchers found a flaw that lets attackers take control of 11 of its home router models.
